desc:
Rug Reader is a hunched fortune-teller from Lost in Random, wrapped in a patched cloak, with huge glowing eyes and a loom of hanging threads beside her.

Lost in Random was the first game our studio contributed to. We built its characters from scratch through the full standard pipeline (high-poly sculpt, retopology, UVs, baking and texturing), at around 10K to 15K tris on 2K maps, keeping the game's dark storybook look of thin limbs, oversized heads and worn, handmade materials.

Need characters built to match your game's art direction? We'll build yours to your style, budget and platform.
